scientific_integrity: Exact finite-field line-arrangement computation using an explicit geometric flex theorem and an entirely reproducible Python 3 checker; the geometric and arithmetic incidence conclusions are stated without claims of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the Hurwitz quintic over the field of five elements; not a result for every characteristic. The indexed literature comparison is bounded and cannot eliminate an unindexed equivalent calculation.
title: Nodal arithmetic of the 42 flex-tangent lines of a Hurwitz quintic in characteristic five
